theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_atm_sum_planes_of_carried
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Z : Set (Euclid P)), Z.Countable → σ Zᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]) → ν = Measure.sum (fun w : Z => σ {(w : Euclid P)} • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V})
